summary: Executed rebuild + targeted API and browser MMS retest on external preview. API bridge endpoints passed. MMS table-picker flow works and core Basic/strategy switching persisted after reload, but 3D struct inspector path and BOM UNPRICED visibility did not pass in UI verification.

ui_bugs.issue: After triggering 'Open 3D shadow view', deterministic StructEditPanel opening via scene clicks could not be achieved in 3 attempts; mms-structure-inspector and mms-component-picker were not reachable.
UNPRICED label was not visible in rendered BOM UI during seeded MMS scenarios where unpriced MMS hardware is expected.

integration_issues.issue: Engineering wind-pressure line remained 'Not calculated' in UI after setting V and k1-k4 during automation path; commit pathway likely not persisting from current field interaction flow.

issues: Stress edits produced large conflict banners (e.g., many roof-boundary clashes); feedback is visible (good) but can dominate workflow readability on high panel counts.

action_items: Fix/regression-test 3D toggle + pick workflow so scene click reliably opens StructEditPanel and mms-component-picker.
Ensure MMS BOM spec line renders UNPRICED label visibly in Step9 for zero-priced MMS hardware rows.
Validate engineering field commit lifecycle so reference pressure updates when required inputs are provided.
After fixes, rerun full 3D proof: visible rails/braces/anchors with one confirmed 3D artifact capture.
critical_code_review_comments: Scene3D.tsx remains extremely large (well beyond 700 lines), increasing risk in interaction regressions (toggle/pick paths).
Most interactive controls still lack data-testid attributes outside MMS-specific additions, reducing deterministic UI testability across core flows.
Hook dependency warnings from build are still present (Step2Roof, Step6Editor, Scene3D).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-ONLY seeded browser storage fixture (solar-studio-v1 migration path) with 2 roofs, 2 segments, and 248 panels for stress testing. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API bridge is healthy on preview. Step6 mms-table-picker + selected-table-settings path is functional and persistence/undo path partly validated. Remaining blockers are 3D struct inspector determinism and missing UNPRICED visibility in BOM UI. Use artifact /app/test_reports/artifacts/final_20260918_141421.jpeg as latest rooftop stress snapshot (not validated as successful 3D inspector state).
rca of the issue: RCA-1: 3D interaction path remains non-deterministic from automation despite deterministic table selector updates; likely scene pick/event routing or mode state prevents StructEditPanel opening from click targets. Repro: seed fixture -> wizard/6 -> generate MMS -> open 3D -> click likely members; inspector not opened in 3 attempts. RCA-2: MMS BOM emitter prefixes UNPRICED in spec/formula, but Step9 UI did not surface UNPRICED in tested render path; likely presentation/filtering issue in BOM row/spec rendering under current state. RCA-3: Engineering panel data entry in automation did not produce computed pressure in UI line, suggesting value commit coupling to component-specific interaction lifecycle.
